messages:
mina: Heads-up — bringing up qwen-2 via loom-bridge into our int8 pipeline. Quick smoke shows embedding drift and a small summarization quality regression on long-doc news-sum. Repro below.

mina: Repro commands:
```
python tools/loom_convert.py --src qwen-2 --out ./qwen2-loom/ --quant=ptq-int8 --group=256
./eval/harness --model ./qwen2-loom/ --task news-sum --max-tokens 2048 --seed 3
python eval/embeddings_check.py --model ./qwen2-loom/ --dataset wiki-10k
```

jorge: Numbers?

mina: Rouge-L -3.2 vs fp32 on long-doc split, embedding cosine mean drops 0.012 vs fp32 baseline for wiki-10k, weird sentinel tokens showing up mid-outputs ~1.7% of summaries. PPL +0.45.

sam: Sentinel tokens appearing mid-sequence suggests vocab id mapping or pad/tokenizer offsets. Did you run token-id parity check?

mina: Ran `tools/tokenmap_check --ref ./models/qwen2-fp32 --alt ./qwen2-loom/` — shows shift: token id 50256 maps to 50255 in converted model (off by -1) in the trailing region of vocab.

natalie: That explains sentinel leakage. Also, long-doc degradation could be rotary/freq normalization subtlety for qwen variants with long context. Any per-head scale diffs?

mina: I dumped headwise phase scales for first 12 layers: heads 2/5/9 have scale ~1.0004 vs fp32. Small but could amplify across 2k tokens.

jorge: Quick ablations: 1) run conversion with explicit tokenmap fix (apply +1 to trailing ids) and re-eval, 2) apply per-head phase multiplier inverse 0.9996 and re-eval, 3) try group-size 128/256 int8.

ci-bot: CI job queued: 1749995555-loom-quant-audit.

mina: Ran tokenmap fix + re-run: sentinel mid-output drops to 0.1% and Rouge-L improves ~1.4 pts. Embedding cosine still -0.008.

mina: Applied headwise phase inv *0.9996 on affected heads and re-run embedding check: cosine delta now -0.002 and Rouge-L gap down to ~0.8. Group-size 128 gave minor benefit but not as strong.

natalie: Good. Action items: 1) add tokenmap parity check to converter (reject converts if trailing-region aliasing detected), 2) add head-phase sanity check + optional auto-correct shim in loom_convert, 3) add a small long-doc smoke eval (2 examples, 2k tokens) to CI for new converts. I'll file MLD-5012.

sam: I'll open PR for converter checks + CI smoke. Also propose storing per-model tokenizer tail-offset metadata in catalog so convert doesn't guess. ETA EOD tomorrow.

ci-bot: Job finished: 1749995555-loom-quant-audit (artifacts: /ci/artifacts/1749995555/).
